# B·Heaven by Barceló Dubai

> Rooftop lounge, restaurant, and pool terrace at Barceló Al Jaddaf, Dubai. Panoramic skyline views of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Frame, contemporary Levantine dining, artisan mixology, shisha, and signature events.

## Core Navigation & Experiences

- [Homepage](https://bheavendubai.com/): Overview of B·Heaven rooftop dining, pool lounge, live entertainment, and table reservations.
- [A La Carte Food & Drinks Menu](https://bheavendubai.com/menu/): Mediterranean-Levantine cold and hot mezze, signature mains, chef's pass, artisan cocktails, mocktails, premium wines, and spirits.
- [Rooftop Shisha Menu](https://bheavendubai.com/shisha/): Single and blended premium hookah flavours, ice pipes, and custom blends.
- [Business Lunch](https://bheavendubai.com/business-lunch/): 2-course and 3-course weekday business lunch packages with skyline views.
- [Jazz Friday Night](https://bheavendubai.com/jazz-friday-dubai/): Weekly live jazz duo performance, sharing platters, and craft cocktails every Friday.
- [Layali Night](https://bheavendubai.com/layali-night-dubai/): Classic Arabic songs with Nouha Issa every Saturday from 9 PM, shisha and late-night plates, free entry, reservation required.
- [Grape & Graze](https://bheavendubai.com/grape-and-graze-dubai/): Every Thursday from 8 PM, a cheese board, Levantine mezze and two glasses of wine for AED 99 per person.
- [Ibiza Sunday Pool Brunch](https://bheavendubai.com/ibiza-brunch-dubai/): Unlimited poolside BBQ, live resident DJ, pool pass access, and cocktails every Sunday.

## Operational Details

- Hours: Daily 12:00 PM – 2:00 AM
- Address: Rooftop, Occidental Al Jaddaf, 328 Al Khail Rd, Al Jaddaf, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Reservations: WhatsApp +971 50 612 9150 / Phone +971 4 596 9999
- Cuisine: Mediterranean & Levantine Fusion
- Atmosphere: Rooftop lounge, skyline dining, pool terrace, sunset cocktails
- Dress Code: Smart Casual
